# YM39: 曲院风荷 Quyuan Fenghe, "Yeast Courtyard, Wind, and Lotus"

Wave 1 · Yuanming Yuan · 3D: `/reconstruction/3d.html?b=YM39` · Page: `/scenes/#YM39` · Row: `research/buildings/YM39-quyuan-fenghe/`

## What it was

曲院风荷 Quyuan Fenghe, "Lotus in the Breeze at the Brewery Yard", east of 碧桐书院 and south-east of 坐石临流: a five-bay hall facing south, with the Buddhist tower 洛迦胜境 to its west (S05 j82:26b; E2077). South of it a nine-opening bridge crossed the lotus pool east-west between two archways, 金鳌 west and 玉蝀 east; 四围佳丽 beyond the river south-west of 金鳌; the pavilion 饮练长虹 east of 玉蝀; then over a bridge north-east the walled mock town gate 宁和镇 and, south-east of it, 东楼门 (S05 j82:27a-27b; E2078). 宁和镇 was renamed 春和镇 early in Daoguang's reign (S361 v3 p.112; E2081), which matches the plan's 春和镇. Burned in October 1860; in 1871 the 金鳌 and 玉蝀 archways still stood (S203; E0433).

From the inventory row: **built** by 1744 (first dated item); **changed** Differs on later plans (S41); housed 南府 eunuchs in Qianlong-Jiaqing (S43); **destroyed** 1860 (S05, S02, S08, S41, S43, S01, S360).

## The scene itself

### The leaf of 1744, its poem and preface

Leaf 39 of the 1744 album. Preface: "西湖麴院為宋時酒務地荷花最多" (the brewery yard on West Lake, a Song state brewery, had the most lotus). Here red lotus covers the water and the long bridge's reflection sways, so the place takes that name. The quatrain sets a pair of ducks asleep under the flowers (S40, printed in S05 j82:26b-27a; E2073).

### How later sources differ

日下旧闻考 gives the bridge and archways (E2078). Malone: a great curved bridge on nine arches over a pretty lotus pond, "leading nowhere in particular" (S02 pp.94-96; E2080). Name 宁和镇 to 春和镇 under Daoguang (E2081; E2393).

Record 2455 (no catalogue data; E2083): a long narrow lotus pool crossed by a nine-arch stone bridge, embankments round it and a stream beyond; the buildings (曲院风荷, 洛伽胜境) on a small island north of the pool across a stream, joined by winding galleries. The 初编 has one page, p.228 (E2082).

## Interior and setting

### Interior

Plaques 曲院风荷 and 洛迦胜境 in Qianlong's hand; 饮练长虹 and 宁和镇 also (S05 j82:26b-27b; E2077, E2078). 洛迦胜境 is a Buddhist tower, so it held images; no inventory seen.

| Row | Kind | What | Source | Quote or basis | Grade | Seen |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| YM39-02 | object | Guanyin cult: Jiaqing's poems at 曲院风荷 speak of the South Sea (Putuo) and Guanyin, matching the name 洛迦胜境 (Potalaka); an image of Guanyin in the tower is my inference | S360 p.257 items (2), (4) (E2075, E2076), Jiaqing 1796, 1802 | 西方常住锡，南海永安澜 (1796); 海南卓锡畅宗风 (1802) | C | viewed |

### The garden around it

A lotus pool with red lotus ("紅衣印波", E2073) crossed by the nine-opening bridge with an archway at each end (E2078, E2080). Ducks (E2073).

P0039 draws the nine-arch bridge 九孔桥 frontally: nine round arches rising to the centre, white arch rings and balustrade, yellow-brown stone spandrels, a 牌坊 with red props at the west end and a double-eaved octagonal pavilion and second 牌坊 at the east end; behind it a walled street of small houses with a gate tower (宁和镇, my tie). The woodcut P0088 shows lotus over the lake. (S08 P0039, crop ym39_c1; S76 P0088)
